title: Box time
ahead: The box is {amount} ahead of this device.
behind: The box is {amount} behind this device.
strongHint: Secure connections and updates fail while the clock is this far off. Check which clock is right before changing it.
timezoneHint: Schedules and the touch screen use it.
ntpHint: The box sets its clock from time servers on the internet.
setFromDeviceHint: The box is not synchronized. It can take this device’s time instead, and stop using NTP.
deviceConfirmTitle: Set the box time from this device?
deviceConfirmHint: The box will take this device’s time ({time}) and stop setting its clock automatically.
stepWarning: This moves the box’s clock by {amount}. Moving it back can break secure connections and updates until the time is right again.
restartRequired: Restart to use the new time zone
restartHint: Calaos server and the touch screen read the time zone when they start.
serverRestarting: Calaos server is restarting. This page reconnects by itself.
